The patient was adamant in stating that recent bowel movements were normal in color, denying any past or present occurrence of black tarry stools. The patient is a non-smoker and keeps a balanced diet but has a family history of diabetes. Taking into consideration his clinical presentation and past medical history, despite denying certain important risk factors, further investigations were deemed necessary.
